lines.text: @sea_dusk lies calm under a wash of amber light.
A slow pan drifts along the quiet horizon.
Small swells fold and glide toward the shore.
The last of the sun sinks, and the sky turns violet.
Light shimmers on the water, soft and unhurried.
The logo fades in over the sea and settles.
It holds still as the dusk deepens.

writes.note: I drafted a calm, visual dusk scene around your logo and slow pan, with no dialogue.

reply.rationale: Expanded the one-line idea into seven short visual beats (about 14 s) ending on the logo settling, keeping @sea_dusk as the location.
